**Company Description**
BangDB is a multimodal converged database platform designed to simplify and accelerate development of modern data-intensive applications. By handling application logic through user-defined and customized schemas, BangDB reduces development costs while enabling faster, higher-quality feature delivery. The platform natively integrates document databases, stream and graph processing, AI/ML operations, vector indexing for RAG workflows, workflow orchestration, and high-performance databases across devices, clouds, and peer-to-peer computing. BangDB is widely used across sectors such as fintech, retail, ecommerce, healthcare, CRM, infrastructure, DevOps, and IoT. It supports use cases including real-time monitoring, personalization and recommendations, fraud and threat detection, customer experience optimization, visitor insights, and master data management with strong scalability and cost efficiency.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time remote role for a Full Stack Engineer at BangDB. The Full Stack Engineer will design, develop, and maintain end-to-end web applications that integrate with BangDB’s converged data platform. Daily responsibilities include implementing and optimizing front-end interfaces, building robust back-end services and APIs, and ensuring seamless communication between application layers. The role involves collaborating with product and data teams to translate complex data workflows into intuitive, performant features, as well as writing clean, testable code and participating in code reviews. The engineer will also contribute to performance tuning, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of the overall application architecture.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Full-Stack Development and Software Development skills, with experience building and maintaining production-grade applications.
* Candidates should possess solid Back-End Web Development skills, including designing APIs, working with databases, and managing application logic and performance.
* Candidates should possess Front-End Development skills using modern frameworks, with proficiency in Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) for responsive and accessible user interfaces.
* Candidates should possess familiarity with modern development tools and practices, such as version control (Git), testing frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and containerization (e.g., Docker).
* Experience with data-intensive systems, stream processing, or distributed architectures is beneficial, especially in domains such as fintech, ecommerce, or IoT.
* A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong problem-solving abilities, effective communication skills, and the capacity to work independently in a remote, collaborative environment.

**About Teleradiology Solutions / Daignostix**
Teleradiology Solutions (TRS), founded in 2002 by two Yale-trained physicians and headquartered in Ardmore, PA, provides 24x7 diagnostic radiology reporting to over 150 hospitals across 21 countries, through a network of radiologists (US, Indian certified) and technology-driven workflows.
  
  
Daignostix, the AI arm of TRS based in Whitefield, Bengaluru, builds clinical AI for medical imaging and healthcare workflows. TRS also maintains an active academic and research focus, including AI in radiology (www.radguru.net).
  
  
**Role Summary**
Daignostix builds the AI behind TRS's 24x7 teleradiology operations and the products used by radiologists, hospital partners and internal teams. Beyond clinical imaging models, this includes algorithms that route and prioritise cases, predict TAT and forecast volumes and radiologist coverage, along with mobile applications that put these capabilities in users' hands.
  
  
As a Junior AI Engineer – Applied AI (Non-Clinical), you will build and ship operational ML algorithms and AI-enabled mobile features end to end under the guidance of senior engineers, using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code to move quickly without compromising quality. This role does not work on clinical diagnostic models.

* Operational algorithms. Build, train and evaluate models for case routing and worklist prioritisation, TAT prediction, radiologist scheduling and RVU/volume forecasting, and anomaly detection on operational data.

* AI-assisted development. Use Claude Code and similar agentic coding tools in day-to-day development, while owning the review, testing and correctness of everything you ship.
* Production engineering. Package models as tested services (Python, Docker, FastAPI) with unit and regression tests, logging and monitoring. Senior engineers lead architecture and deployment.
* Stakeholder collaboration. Work with operations, product and engineering teams to turn workflow problems into measurable AI solutions.

**Requirements**
**Must-have:**

* Education. B.Tech/B.E./M.Tech/MS/M.Sc. from an IIT, IISc, IIIT, BITS Pilani or a comparably selective institution, in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, AI, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics or a related quantitative field, with a strong academic record.

jobs.description:
**Job Title**
Engineer - Java, AWS
  
  
**Job Description**
**So, who are we?**
IG Group is a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents, serving over 1.4m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions – built on scale, trust, and proof. We didn’t pivot to innovation; it’s how we’ve always operated. What that means for the people who work here is real: genuinely complex problems to solve, the technology and resources to tackle them properly, and the kind of scope that’s rare in established businesses.
  
  
The bar is high – bring a curious and forward-thinking mindset and we’ll give you the platform to define what comes next.
  
  
Join us at IG – the future gets built here.
  
  
**Your Team**
Join IG’s Prime Core team, which is responsible for building the open-spec trading APIs and solutions that support institutional and retail clients, delivering secure, high-performance, low-latency solutions.
  
  
**Your Role In The Team’s Success**
Our team sits within the IG Prime division, serving institutional and retail businesses. The Prime Core team owns the APIs that connect IG to institutional clients, brokers and partners across global markets — onboarding client accounts, funding, and the trading and market-data platform that our largest clients depend on every trading day.
  
  
That means real-time price distribution, order and execution flow, and reference data, running continuously through the trading day. When these systems degrade, clients notice immediately — so resilience, correctness and latency aren’t aspirations here; they’re the job. You’ll join at a genuinely interesting point: we’re building a new suite of cloud-native trading APIs.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Write production Java that other people have to maintain: tested, readable, and honest about its edge cases.
* Work in a spec-driven, AI-assisted development workflow — specifying intent clearly, using AI tooling to move fast, and reviewing what comes back with a critical eye.
* Contribute to design discussions and technical decisions. You won’t be handed a spec and left alone; you’ll be in the room while we work out what to build.
* Deploy and run what you build in AWS, and learn how the cloud behaves when things go wrong.
* Investigate production issues alongside more experienced engineers — working from logs, metrics, traces and JVM diagnostics to get from symptom to root cause under time pressure.
* Grow into deeper ownership of services as you build confidence in the systems.

**What You’ll Need**

* Experience: 3–5 years of professional Java development experience, including hands-on AWS.
* Java: solid commercial experience writing Java in a production environment — this is the core of the role, and the thing we’ll dig into most.
* JVM: a real understanding of how the JVM behaves at runtime — memory management and garbage collection, the Java memory model, and how threads actually interact rather than how we hope they do.
* Concurrency and multi-threading: working knowledge, including the ways concurrent code fails: visibility problems, contention, and bugs that only appear under load.
* JVM diagnostics: practical skills reading thread and heap dumps, reasoning about GC behaviour, profiling, and narrowing down a memory leak or a contention problem rather than restarting and hoping.
* Spring: experience with the Spring Framework, ideally Spring Boot.
* AWS: hands-on experience — you’ve deployed and debugged something real in the cloud, and you understand the services you’ve used rather than just the commands you ran.
* AI coding tools: practical experience using them as part of your normal workflow, and the judgement to know when their output is wrong. We care much more about how critically you evaluate AI-generated code than how much of it you produce.
* Linux: comfort on Linux, including basic shell scripting.
* Curiosity: when something doesn’t add up, and the persistence to keep digging rather than working around it.
* Willingness to ask questions early and often. In a domain this specific, the engineers who learn fastest are the ones who ask.

**The Perks**
It really is more than a job. We think like a start-up, but we deliver like a FTSE 100 — so the bar is high, and we won’t pretend otherwise. We’ll recognise your talent and make sure that you can still have a life – at work, and outside of it. Networks, committees, awards, sports and social clubs, mentorships, volunteering opportunities, extra time off... the list goes on.
  
  

* Matched giving for your fundraising activity
* Hybrid working model – three days a week in the office
* Performance-related bonuses
* Insurance and medical plans
* Free access to the LinkedIn Learning platform
* Contribution to gym memberships and more
* Employee Assistance Program
